# [twitchtv/twirp] instrumentation for OpenTelemetry Go

[Twirp](https://github.com/twitchtv/twirp) is a service to service communication framework.

This package provides autoinstrumentation for twirp services using server hooks.

## Installation
```
go get github.com/github/otel-instrumentation-go/oteltwirp
```

## Usage

Refer to [twirp's documentation](https://twitchtv.github.io/twirp/docs/intro.html) on how to use twirp.

See the [examples folder](./example) for a minimal example of how to use this library.
